items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for the managed fleet; blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch. Fleet-doctor is unavailable with no checks or site results, operations deploy/uptime/error sweeps are unavailable, and authentication boundaries, secret handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, incident monitoring, and disclosure readiness are therefore unevidenced. No clean bill of health is supported. Compliance records 15 failures and 7 unknowns across 59 sites; TLS has no certificates expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS or header coverage. Recent worker failures, including exit 137, reviewer rejection, and a dirty isolated worktree, are operational containment signals but not proof of exploitation. Recommendation: retain production-change pause, continue only bounded read-only security evidence capture and existing incident repair, and keep SearchWoot private until security evidence and the other launch gates are complete.

Security recommendation: do not approve any go-live, public exposure, dependency adoption, credential change, or release expansion this cycle. Exact decision: maintain the private SearchWoot gate and reject new production security-sensitive work until access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release provenance, TLS, dependency review, data handling, monitoring, incident response, and disclosure-readiness evidence are attached and reviewed.
